steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Copland's style features open harmonies (wide-spaced chords), sparse textures, and folk-derived melodies — his Americana sound defines mid-20th century US orchestral music.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: British composers combined pastoral tradition with modernism: Britten's dramatic orchestration, Tavener's spiritual minimalism, Maxwell-Davies's folk-modernist fusion.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Fanfare for the Common Man uses open fifths, brass sonority and slow-building dynamics to create monumental, democratic grandeur.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Britten's Young Person's Guide shows orchestral variation technique — each instrument family is showcased through Purcell-based variations.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always use PRECISE musical vocabulary — not vague descriptions like it sounds nice Reference SPECIFIC musical elements when analysing any piece For listening questions: identify elements FIRST, then explain their effect For study pieces: know the context, structure and key features in detail For performing: focus on accuracy, expression and interpretation For composing: show development of ideas, not just repetition
